name: clarity-booking-staff-app
description: The Clarity Booking staff app (iPhone and Android): the live Booking workspace plus Tap to Pay. Its own package so the Player app (source/) never picks up the Terminal plugin.

scripts.native:sync: npm run native:version && npx cap sync
scripts.native:ios: npm run native:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.native:android: npm run native:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.native:release:aab: npm run native:version && npx cap sync android && node ../scripts/native-release.mjs aab booking-app
scripts.native:release:apk: npm run native:version && npx cap sync android && node ../scripts/native-release.mjs apk booking-app
